tasks.short: Initially assess an athlete's injury or illness and determine care or physician referral needs.

steps.what: Obtain actual injury or illness history, athlete concerns and consent for the assessment
Perform the actual initial injury or illness assessment and determine emergency, continued-care or physician-referral needs within professional scope
outputs: actual assessment findings and clinical decision

steps.what: Record the actual assessment and decision with existing athlete and encounter identifiers
inputs: actual assessment findings and clinical decision

steps.what: Check the completed actual assessment note v1 against actual findings and the trainer's decision
inputs: actual assessment findings and clinical decision

steps.what: Save the exact checked initial assessment note v1 in the same athlete health record

tasks.design: Configure native encounter-header reuse in the athlete health-record system {OTHER}. The trainer performs the actual history and assessment, decides the care or referral need and writes the actual findings; only repeated identifiers shrink before the final note check and separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated encounter identifiers can add a little note-entry work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked encounter forms may already support header reuse.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, examination and referral decisions require the responsible clinician.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise the actual athlete's condition and act within professional scope.

ambition.what: No autonomous assessment or referral decision.

tasks.altitude: A small reduction in note headers; clinical work and rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Preserve actual findings and uncertainty separately from a definitive diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Native encounter forms can reuse existing identifiers while clinical findings remain manually authored.

assumptions: Boundary is the initial assessment, decision and its record. Actual treatment and an actual referral send are separate tasks and receive no saving credit here; any included send needs its own final-package approval. Shares are provisional.

The athlete produces the actual account and consent; the trainer produces actual observations and decisions. The health record supplies existing athlete id and encounter date. Missing identifiers are entered and checked manually. No symptoms or findings are copied forward as current facts.
Native configuration first. No clinical capture, physical assessment, decision, substantive note or same-system save saving. Urgent care cannot wait for a software draft.
unknowns: Actual record-entry share and professional scope
research_questions: Can native header reuse remove real repeated entry without carrying forward stale findings?

already_counted.description: Actual clinical note and final check.

incremental.description: Maintain encounter-header mapping after record-system changes.

approvals.approved_version: actual history and assessment consent for the stated assessment scope; changed consent or scope requires reconfirmation
checked initial assessment note v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Reused headers remove only 1.8 of the provisional 18 note-entry hours less 0.3 upkeep. Already populated headers yield no gross saving; the complete clinical assessment and note meaning remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess recovering athletes and report progress to coaches or physicians.

steps.what: Assess the recovering athlete's actual progress and capture current findings, symptoms and limitations
Write the actual progress report for the named physician or coach using only the allowed recipient-specific information

loop.purpose: Draft the trainer's progress account for the authorised recipient.
loop.input: Actual current findings, trainer interpretation, permitted disclosure and recipient.
loop.output: Progress report draft with source-linked findings and limits.
loop.check: Trainer checks current versus prior findings, clinical meaning, restrictions and uncertainty, and that coach-facing text reveals only allowed information; no clearance is inferred.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported interpretation returns to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields can show measures but cannot express the trainer's actual clinical interpretation in recipient-appropriate prose.

steps.what: Check the complete progress report v1 and exact recipient against actual assessment and disclosure authorisation
Send the exact approved progress report v1 to the named authorised external physician or coach
Discuss the actual progress and restrictions with the receiving coach or physician and clarify questions within the permitted scope

tasks.design: Use native recipient-specific templates in the athlete health record {OTHER}, with a bounded report draft only over actual trainer findings and interpretation. The trainer checks clinical meaning and permitted disclosure in the final report before its separate secure send, then handles questions personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual progress findings must be rewritten for different recipients without overstating recovery.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained draft can phrase the trainer's own interpretation while preserving source facts.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing progress, clinical uncertainty and disclosure permissions remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise whether observed improvement matters and explain unresolved limitations.
tasks.altitude: Less report drafting; assessment and recipient discussion stay personal.

reach.learn: Separate observed progress, trainer interpretation and formal clearance.

evidence.claim: A bounded loop can draft a report from explicit clinical findings and interpretation, with clinician checks; no athletic-training outcome is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes current assessment, actual report, secure send and clarification. {OTHER} is the athlete health-record/secure messaging environment. Shares are provisional.

Trainer manually captures actual date, findings, measures, symptoms, interpretation and restrictions in s1. The record holds actual identity and disclosure authorisation; missing recipient permission or current findings must be resolved manually before drafting or sending. No recording or free ambient feed is assumed.

Native templates first. No physical assessment or recipient discussion saving. This report must be allocated once rather than counted again in general administrative reports. Internal recipients require write_internal rather than act_external.
unknowns: Recipient-specific disclosure permissions and secure messaging support
research_questions: Does source-grounded drafting retain restrictions and disclosure limits with less total writing and correction?

already_counted.description: Clinical meaning and disclosure checks during drafting.
Final report, recipient and disclosure approval.

incremental.description: Maintain recipient-specific template and source access constraints.

approvals.approved_version: approved progress report v1 and exact authorised recipient/disclosure scope; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A report with complete actual findings removes 12 of the provisional 30 drafting hours less 1 upkeep. Sparse findings require more manual writing; assessment, final disclosure check, send and clarification remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate readiness to play and provide warranted participation clearances.

steps.what: Review actual recovery evidence, current restrictions and applicable readiness procedure
Evaluate the athlete's actual current functioning and readiness within professional scope
Decide whether participation clearance is warranted and authorised, including any restrictions or required physician decision
Write the actual clearance or non-clearance document using existing athlete and encounter identifiers
Check the completed participation document v1 against the actual decision, restrictions, authority and intended recipient
Provide the exact approved participation decision document v1 to its authorised external recipient

tasks.design: Configure native readiness-reference links and identifier reuse in the athlete health-record system {OTHER}. Assessment, clearance judgement and all substantive restrictions stay human; the trainer checks the complete decision document before its separate handover, with no automated eligibility judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current evidence and procedure references may require navigation, and document headers repeat existing identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked records and controlled forms can reduce those specific operations.
tasks.still_hard: Readiness and who may issue clearance depend on the actual clinical situation and professional authority.
tasks.human_edge: Withhold clearance when the evidence or authority is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: Less reference and header work; the full readiness decision stays human.

reach.learn: Respect the authorised decision and communicate its exact limits.

evidence.claim: Native forms can reuse identifiers and link approved references without deciding readiness to play.

assumptions: Boundary includes readiness evaluation and its explicit clearance output. Professional authority is unchanged; a required physician clearance is not replaced by a trainer's note. Shares are provisional.

Trainer produces actual assessment and decision; responsible clinicians maintain actual restrictions; procedure owners supply current approved method versions. The record supplies existing athlete id and encounter fields. Missing restrictions or authority require manual clarification, never inferred clearance.

Try native configuration first. The 15% document reduction is repeated identifiers and layout only; restrictions and decision wording retain full effort. No same-save saving is claimed. If a separate health-status commit exists it needs its own gate and full ordinary save time.
unknowns: Existing reference links and auto-populated document fields
research_questions: Does native form setup remove real repeated entry without defaulting any clinical decision?

already_counted.description: Final readiness document, authority and recipient check.

incremental.description: Maintain reference links and nonclinical header mapping.

approvals.approved_version: approved participation decision document v1 with exact restrictions and authorised recipient; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native reference links remove 3 hours and repeated headers remove 2.7 per provisional 100 task hours, less 0.7 upkeep. Already linked forms offer no gross gain; physical evaluation, clearance judgement, final check and handover stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep general administrative records and write activity reports.

steps.what: Capture and verify actual administrative activity facts, dates and missing record details
Organise existing administrative records and prepare specified activity totals by period and category
Write the general administrative activity report from actual checked facts and totals

loop.purpose: Draft factual activity commentary from actual records and explicit trainer explanations.
loop.input: Checked activity table, facts, period and actual exception explanations.
loop.output: Administrative report draft with source links.
loop.check: Trainer checks event meaning, reporting period, exception explanations and omissions against actual records; no care event, cause or outcome is inferred.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported commentary returns to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native totals do not express the trainer's supplied explanation of exceptions.

steps.what: Check the completed administrative report v1 for actual activity accuracy, privacy and named internal use
Save the exact approved administrative report v1 in the same document store
Send the exact approved administrative report v1 to its named authorised internal manager

tasks.design: Configure native administrative queries in the athlete health-record environment {OTHER}, using {SPREADSHEET} only where it already bridges the report. Add a bounded {DOCS} commentary draft from actual checked totals and trainer explanations; final privacy and meaning checks precede separate save and internal send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity totals and commentary can be repeatedly assembled for internal reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and constrained factual drafting can repeat assembly while exposing sources.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete activity records and sensitive information require actual capture and review.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a misleading activity total and explain the real exception.

ambition.what: No new clinical or performance-monitoring decisions.

tasks.altitude: Less report assembly; actual records and privacy accountability remain.

reach.learn: Use actual event dates and distinguish missing data from no activity.

evidence.claim: Native reports and source-grounded commentary can reduce administrative assembly without replacing actual event capture.

assumptions: Boundary is general administrative record organisation and internal activity reports. Clinical assessment notes, progress reports and clearance records already costed in the other tasks are excluded from duplicate authorship; their completed records may be inputs only. Shares are provisional.

The trainer manually captures actual activity id, date, type, status and missing details in s1; existing clinical records are produced by responsible clinicians. The manager supplies period, categories and authorised audience; the trainer supplies actual exception explanations. Missing categories or explanations require manual completion, not free tagging or invented causes.
Try native reports first. No planned care is counted as completed. Actual capture, final review, save and internal send stay full; there is no new staff evaluation service.
unknowns: Existing query coverage and privacy restrictions
research_questions: Which administrative totals and prose are currently reassembled after actual records already exist?

already_counted.description: Check administrative table sources and category totals.
Check generated commentary against actual records and explanations.
Final report meaning and privacy check.

incremental.description: Maintain reporting categories and draft constraints after administrative changes.

approvals.approved_version: approved administrative report v1; edits void approval
approved administrative report v1 and exact authorised internal manager; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Recurring reports remove 8 table-assembly hours and 17.5 prose hours per provisional 100 task hours less 1 upkeep. Sparse categories leave more manual completion; actual fact capture, privacy review, save and send remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
